summary: Describes an RTP payload format for carrying AC-3 audio. AC-3 is a multichannel audio coding system used in United States HDTV, DVD and other media. The format includes support for fragmentation. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Movie sound with many speakers is packed into a code called AC-3. This memo shows how to cut that sound into pieces and send it over the internet.

questions: what is rtp payload format for ac-3
how are ac-3 frames fragmented in rtp
what is the sdp line for ac3
subtitle: How to carry Dolby Digital style AC-3 multichannel audio inside RTP packets, including splitting large frames.

tldr.problem: AC-3 is a multichannel audio format used in DVD, HDTV and other media, and people want to stream it over IP networks, where frames can be larger than a packet.
tldr.mechanism: Each RTP packet starts with a two-byte header whose Frame Type and Number of Frames fields say whether the payload holds whole AC-3 frames or one fragment of a frame. A media type and SDP mapping describe the stream.
tldr.outcome: AC-3 can be streamed over RTP with whole-frame packing or fragmentation. Encryption and authentication are left to other mechanisms such as SRTP.

today: RFC 4184 is a Proposed Standard published in October 2005, and the unit metadata lists no obsoleting or updating RFC. It defines the payload only for AC-3, not E-AC-3.

sections.title: AC-3 and Why It Needs an RTP Format
sections.content:
AC-3 is a high-quality audio codec that encodes multiple channels as a single entity into a low bit-rate format. Dolby Digital is a branded version that encodes up to 5.1 channels. The RFC lists AC-3 as a mandatory codec for DVD-video, ATSC digital terrestrial television and DLNA home networking.

The RFC picks the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP) because it provides stream synchronization. Example uses are streaming movies from a home media server to a display, video on demand, and multichannel Internet radio.
sections.eli5: AC-3 is the sound recipe used for movies with speakers all around you. This memo is about mailing that sound over the internet in time with the picture.

sections.title: How AC-3 Frames Work
sections.content:
AC-3 can deliver up to 5.1 channels at data rates between 32 kbps and 640 kbps, for signals sampled at 32, 44.1 or 48 kHz. The ".1" is a band-limited, optional low-frequency effects channel.

The stream is a series of synchronization frames. Each frame has a Synchronization Information field, a Bit Stream Information field, 6 audio blocks of 256 PCM samples each, an optional auxiliary field and an error-correction CRC. A frame spans 1536 PCM samples, which lasts 32 ms at 48 kHz, about 34.83 ms at 44.1 kHz and 48 ms at 32 kHz.
sections.eli5: The sound is chopped into short slices, like frames in a film. Each slice is a little package with a header, six pieces of sound and a check code.

sections.title: RTP Header Fields and Payload Header
sections.content:
The payload type is not fixed by this RFC; it comes from the RTP profile or is signaled out of band, for example with SDP. The M bit is set to one when the packet holds at least one complete AC-3 frame or the final fragment of a frame. The timestamp matches the first frame's sampling instant, the first one SHOULD be random, and it grows by 1536 per frame. Fragments of the same frame MUST carry the same timestamp.

Every payload MUST begin with a two-octet header: a run of must-be-zero bits (MBZ), a two-bit Frame Type (FT) and an 8-bit Number of frames (NF). After it come either whole AC-3 frames or a single fragment. The format covers AC-3 only, and it MUST NOT be used to carry E-AC-3.

FT 0 means one or more complete frames and NF counts them. FT 1 is an initial fragment containing the first 5/8ths of the frame, FT 2 is an initial fragment without that much, and FT 3 is any later fragment. For fragments NF is the number of fragments making up the frame, identical across them. With several whole frames, a receiver finds each frame's length using the frmsizecod field.
sections.eli5: Each package has a tiny label on top saying either "I hold whole slices" or "I hold a piece of a slice, number so-and-so", so the receiver knows how to open it.

sections.title: Fragmenting Large Frames
sections.content:
AC-3 frames range from 128 to 3840 bytes. If a frame exceeds the network MTU it SHOULD be fragmented at the RTP level. Fragmentation MAY happen at any byte boundary, and the packets of one frame SHALL be sent consecutively from first to last so the receiver can reassemble them in order.

A sender MAY make the first fragment hold at least the first 5/8ths of the frame. That portion is guaranteed to contain what is needed to decode the first two audio blocks, which gives better resilience to packet loss. Other fragments are decodable only once the whole frame arrives.
sections.eli5: If a letter is too big for the envelope you cut it in pieces and send them in order. The first piece is made big enough that the listener can already hear a little even if later pieces get lost.

sections.title: Media Type and SDP Usage
sections.content:
The registered media type is audio/ac3. The required parameter rate is the RTP clock rate, equal to the sampling rate, and is 32000, 44100 or 48000. The optional channels parameter, from 1 to 6 with the LFE channel counted, gives the maximum channels sent or the maximum a receiver will output. The type is defined only for RTP transport.

In SDP the media is m=audio and the encoding name ac3 goes in a=rtpmap, as in a=rtpmap:100 ac3/48000/6. In offer/answer exchanges the rate is symmetric, so the answer MUST use the same value or remove the payload type. If channels is omitted, a maximum of 6 is implied.
sections.eli5: Before the show starts, both sides agree on the sound's name and how fast it ticks, like agreeing which language to speak before talking.

sections.title: Security and Congestion Control
sections.content:
The format follows the security considerations of the RTP specification and any RTP profile. Confidentiality, integrity protection and authentication have to come from a mechanism external to the payload format, such as SRTP. The RFC adds that a decoder meeting a malformed AC-3 frame discards it and conceals the error until a valid frame is decoded, which is expected to prevent crashes.

For congestion, the general RTP rules apply. An encoder can adapt by changing its bit rate in real time or by offering several encodings of the content. Putting more frames in each packet reduces IP/UDP/RTP header overhead, at the cost of more delay and less robustness to packet loss.
sections.eli5: The memo does not lock the sound itself; if you want it secret you add a lock from somewhere else. If the road is crowded you can send smaller, lower-quality sound.

fields.name: MBZ
fields.desc: Must be zero; ignored by receivers and reserved for future use.

fields.name: FT
fields.desc: Frame type: 0 complete frames, 1 initial fragment with first 5/8ths, 2 other initial fragment, 3 later fragment.

fields.name: NF
fields.desc: Number of frames, or number of fragments in the frame.
